title: archive state required
summary: The RPC endpoint cannot serve the historical state requested at that block.
likelyCauses: The request needs archive state older than the endpoint retains.
The project or plan is not enabled for archive access on this chain.
nextSteps: Use an archive-capable endpoint for the target chain and block.
Retry against a provider that documents archive data support.

title: chain not supported
summary: The RPC provider does not support the requested chain for this endpoint, product, or account.
likelyCauses: The endpoint URL targets the wrong network identifier.
The provider does not support this chain or feature on the current plan.
nextSteps: Check the provider's supported chain list and endpoint format.
Switch to a supported endpoint or a provider that supports this chain.

title: daily request count exceeded
summary: The RPC provider rejected the request because the project exhausted its daily quota.
likelyCauses: The API key or project exceeded its daily request allowance.
The app is polling or backfilling too aggressively for the plan.
nextSteps: Reduce polling and cache repeated reads.
Wait for quota reset, upgrade the plan, or fail over to another endpoint.

title: invalid api key
summary: The provider rejected the request because the access key, project id, or endpoint credential is invalid.
likelyCauses: API key is missing, mistyped, revoked, or for a different product.
The deployed environment did not inject the expected secret.
nextSteps: Verify the endpoint URL and key in the provider dashboard.
Rotate the key if it may have been revoked or exposed.

title: method disabled
summary: The provider has disabled or does not expose this RPC method on the current endpoint.
likelyCauses: The method is a restricted namespace such as debug_ or trace_.
The project, chain, or product tier does not enable the method.
nextSteps: Check the provider method documentation before retrying.
Move restricted debug or trace calls to a node/provider that supports them.

title: project ID request rate exceeded
summary: The project is over its provider rate limit for the current time window.
likelyCauses: Too many concurrent reads, retries, or backfill requests.
Multiple deployments share the same project id.
nextSteps: Back off with jitter and cap retry attempts.
Add caching, batch where appropriate, or split traffic across approved projects.

title: request timed out
summary: The provider or upstream node did not complete the RPC request before its timeout.
likelyCauses: The method is expensive, the block range is too large, or the upstream node is overloaded.
Network latency or transient provider degradation.
nextSteps: Retry with exponential backoff.
Reduce block ranges or request size, then fail over if timeouts persist.

title: too many requests
summary: The provider is throttling the client because request volume exceeded a rate limit.
likelyCauses: High request concurrency or retry storms.
Polling or indexer backfills exceeded the endpoint's throughput.
nextSteps: Honor 429/rate-limit responses with backoff and jitter.
Cache repeated reads and lower polling frequency.

title: unauthorized
summary: The provider rejected the request because the client is not authenticated or not allowed for this endpoint.
likelyCauses: Missing, invalid, revoked, or origin-restricted API key.
The endpoint requires credentials not present in the request.
nextSteps: Check the provider dashboard for key status, product permissions, and allowed origins.
Use server-side secret injection for private provider credentials.

likelyCauses: Browser CORS restrictions, blocked endpoint, offline network, bad URL, or provider outage.
nextSteps: Use a server-side proxy for private keys, verify CORS support, and test the endpoint from the deployment environment.
title: RPC network request failed
summary: The client could not reach the RPC endpoint from the current runtime.

likelyCauses: The API key, project ID, token, or endpoint URL is wrong, revoked, or not enabled for this chain.
nextSteps: Check environment variables, endpoint URLs, dashboard restrictions, and server-side secret injection.
title: RPC API key invalid
summary: The RPC provider rejected the request because credentials are missing or invalid.
